label: Друг
description: Twelve-mission case drill for друг (friend) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form друг has a zero ending and names the subject. Here друг is the one who arrived, so it stands in the nominative as the grammatical subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative друг adds -а to become друга. Possession with у demands the genitive, marking друга as the owner of the house.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The ending shifts to -у, giving другу. The verb позвонить governs the dative, marking другу as the person called.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of встретить takes the accusative, but because друг is animate, the accusative copies the genitive: друга. Animacy is why the form ends in -а rather than staying друг.

missions.phrase: Я иду в кино с другом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The ending becomes -ом, producing другом. The preposition с meaning together with requires the instrumental, naming другом as the companion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The ending is -е, giving друге. The preposition о meaning about forces the prepositional, the case for the object of one's thoughts.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural is irregular: the stem softens to друзь- and takes -я, giving друзья. As the ones who wait, they stand in the nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The irregular plural stem gives the genitive друзей. The word нет signalling absence governs the genitive, marking the missing friends as друзей.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The softened stem друзь- takes the dative ending -ям, producing друзьям. The verb доверять governs the dative, marking друзьям as those trusted.

missions.phrase: Я пригласил всех друзей на праздник.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object of пригласить would be accusative, but animacy makes the accusative plural copy the genitive plural: друзей. The form matches the genitive, not the nominative друзья, because the noun is animate.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The softened stem друзь- takes -ями, giving друзьями. The preposition с meaning with requires the instrumental, naming друзьями as the company kept.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The softened stem друзь- takes the prepositional ending -ях, giving друзьях. The preposition о meaning about governs the prepositional, marking друзьях as the topic.
